problem: allow() appends now even when the request is rejected, so rejected calls count toward the window, causing indefinite lockout, wrong retry_after and unbounded per-key memory.
The repo has no tests, so the changed allow() behavior (deny-then-recover at retry_after, deque bounded by limit) is unverified.
Pre-existing: _in_window creates and never evicts empty deques, including for read-only remaining/retry_after calls, so distinct keys grow memory without bound.
Pre-existing: _observe accepts NaN now, which permanently disables the time-went-backwards guard and can poison the queue.
